title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
lineage: AudMR > Reel(3 3/4ips) > DVD(WAV 24/96) > FLAC. Akai GX636 > Apogee Mini Me(24/96)/Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring/mastering) >  Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > DVD > Soundforge 8.0 (track IDs and cross fades) > downsampled to 16/44 in r8brain (with dithering) > FLAC(level 8)

ai_review.summary: Exceptional soundboard recording of a quintessential mid‑summer 1973 Dead show, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s soaring solos and magical jams on Playing in the Band, Dark Star and Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an outstanding 1973 performance with tight set construction, inspired playing from the whole band and several standout moments – especially the expansive Playing in the Band, the spell‑binding Dark Star/Eyes of the World suite and a soaring Bird Song. The soundboard source is praised as crystal‑clear and “incredible,” making the listening experience virtually flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (5, 4, 5) and explicitly praise both the musical performance and the superb soundboard recording; the show is described as a highlight of the 1973 run, justifying a rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the tape "exceptional," "incredible" and note that it was taken directly from the soundboard and later dubbed from Garcia’s own stash, resulting in crystal‑clear clarity with no reported dropouts.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Eyes of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid first set with tight song choices that builds into a magical second set; the band moves seamlessly from Americana‑flavored numbers to deep, exploratory jams, maintaining energy and pacing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for soaring solos, perfect tone, inspired playing, and emotive harmonics across multiple songs.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for “dropping bombs,” syncopated intensity, and sharing the spotlight during jams, especially on Playin' and Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano described as twinkling, melding perfectly with Jerry’s guitar, and adding delicate texture throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill Kreutzmann) is highlighted for kicking into his zone and providing a driving rhythmic foundation during jams.
